latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Video Music Generator.

- Generate AI-matched background music for your video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Quick processing on cloud GPUs — typical render time 30-60 seconds, with 1080p MP4 output.
- Simple setup: automatic session and token management for seamless onboarding with 100 free credits.
- Supports common workflows including instant music generation, iterative edits, and batch processing.
- Intuitive interface: route user prompts to upload, export, status, or credit actions.
- Clear pipeline details, helpful error messages, and tips for optimal results.
